game.title: New York Jets at Chicago Bears

lede: Chicago Bears carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#5 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Chicago Bears -12.5 with a fair total of 46.1, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Chicago Bears pass offence vs New York Jets pass defence, which sits +0.314 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

Both starters are confirmed by the schedule feed, so the quarterback term is priced from the learned value of the two players actually named.
